request: When the context given to the app via Context(ctx) is canceled while Run is active and StopTimeout is one hour, the context passed to each server's Stop must not already be done.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: honor shutdown timeout when provided context already canceled (#3695)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > app_test.go
printf %s '' | base64 -d > options_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestApp_ContextCanceled)$' . >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
